```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = ",\\s*")
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Number of films:", nrow(movies)),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  filter(
    is.na(tomatoMeter) | tomatoMeter != 0,
    is.na(audienceScore) | audienceScore != 0
  ) |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE), n = n()) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies_summary, aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, desc(mean_gap)))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Critic-Audience Score Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Negative gaps favor audiences; positive gaps favor critics. Genres shown have at least 100 rows.",
    x = "Mean score gap (Tomatometer - audience score)",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```

```{r}
spiderman <- movies |>
  filter(title %in% c(
    "Spider-Man",
    "Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man 3",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man",
    "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
    "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
    "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
    "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
  )) |>
  mutate(
    actor = case_when(
      title %in% c("Spider-Man", "Spider-Man 2", "Spider-Man 3") ~ "Tobey Maguire",
      title %in% c("The Amazing Spider-Man", "The Amazing Spider-Man 2") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
      title %in% c(
        "Spider-Man: Homecoming",
        "Spider-Man: Far From Home",
        "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
      ) ~ "Tom Holland"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore),
    names_to = "score_source",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    title = factor(title, levels = spiderman$title),
    score_source = recode(
      score_source,
      tomatoMeter = "Tomatometer",
      audienceScore = "Audience"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = title, y = score, color = score_source, group = score_source)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Critics Score the Films Slightly Higher Overall",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Mean scores: ",
      round(mean(spiderman$tomatoMeter), 1),
      " critics vs. ",
      round(mean(spiderman$audienceScore), 1),
      " audiences."
    ),
    x = "Film (release order)",
    y = "Score",
    color = "Score source"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
